# Colors tear-out compares geometry before its first data load

## Context

[Engine E2E shard 9](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45015104977/job/137185758894) failed on `dev` `78013b10fc` in Colors tear-out row 1. The popup survived and the source retained the expected two panes.

## The Problem

The initial pane union was y=117, height=571. The settled union was y=124, height=564. Both end at y=688. In the hosted trace, the data-source label changed from WebSocket to local generation between the initial read and popup navigation. The longer label moved the Bar Chart button to the second toolbar row before pointer-up.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: the `expectPanesRefill` JSDoc says the panes must cover the same pre-gesture area after settling. `Colors.view.ViewportController#updateWidgets` selects the first data source before it fills the grid. The existing BackendFallback E2E spec uses a visible column A data cell as receipt of that first batch.

## The Fix

In row 1, wait for a rendered grid data cell before reading the pre-drag pane union. Keep both backend and fallback modes valid.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The row-1 baseline is captured after the initial data load and before the pointer moves.
- [ ] The popup, two-pane refill geometry, and chart text checks remain in the same scenario and pass.

## Out of Scope

Colors data-source policy, geometry tolerances, and native window placement.

## Related

#21363

The closed `#21453` and `#21455` cases had the torn-out pane return to the source. The current return receipt reports two panes and a remove delta.
